source: Park, R. and Dai Ruitong (1988). A comparison of the behaviour of reinforced concrete beam-column joints designed for ductility and limited ductility. Bulletin NZNSEE 21(4), 255-278. Fig. 16(a) (p. 267), Table 4 (p. 264), section 4.1 (pp. 267-268), Table 5.1 of PEER 2003/10 (p. 51) for the tabulated observations.
supersedes: unit1_observed_digitized.json (version 1, manual reading of a 300 dpi render, 2026-09-27)
reason: Codex Unit 1 review 2026-09-28: branch-specific redigitization with pixel coordinates and the axis transformation; the v1 residual targets (35 and 42 mm) and the single unsigned pinching target (28 kN) are not accepted; run labels audited; the +-3 kN / +-3 mm reading bounds are estimated resolution, not statistical confidence

image.render: pdftoppm 400 dpi of the bulletin's scanned page 267, cropped to the Unit 1 panel
image.curve_ink: connected components at least 40 px long in one direction, excluding thin horizontal dashes (the V1/V2 lines) and thin short marks (ticks); drops the printed run numbers and axis labels before any curve analysis

ticks.method: short isolated ink segments touching the axis, assigned to the printed values by the regular spacing that explains the most of them; the V scale is searched within 10 % of the Delta scale (equal tick spacing on the figure, verified on the overlay)

digitization.interpretation: estimated reading bounds; an obscured reversal carries an explicit interval on top of the band
digitization.method: digitize_fig16a.py: ink threshold, connected-component curve mask, axis-line fits, tick consensus, loop-tip detection, heading-based branch tracing, independent axis-crossing detection; overlay fig16a_audit_overlay.png

maximum_load_kN.source: section 4.1 text and PEER Table 5.1; Vmax / V2 = 1.11

yield_displacement_mm.basis: inferred: mu = 2 falls at about 30 mm and mu = 7 at about 105 mm on Fig. 16(a); the paper text does not print Delta_y for Unit 1 (Ref. 8 report); the OpenSees example's peakpts (30, 45, 60, 75, 90, 105) imply the same 15 mm
yield_displacement_mm.status: inferred, provisional; the model never rescales the history by it

load_controlled_first_cycle.basis: 0.75 x V2 in both directions (section 3.2, Fig. 15)
load_controlled_first_cycle.note: the displacement reached at the load target is the initial-compliance observable; the tip force read from the figure differs from 54.45 kN by the reading/obscuration interval and is not the target

independent_crossings.note: columns/rows where ink crosses an axis; a bundle of n strands holds n unresolved branches

amplitude_audit.status: the pixel tips lie within about 1.5 mm of mu x 15 mm on both sides; the reconstruction stands with the +-3 mm coherent shift as its sensitivity

residual_displacement_at_zero_load_mm.basis: unloading branches from +90 and +105 mm reach V = 0 at about 35 and 42 mm
residual_displacement_at_zero_load_mm.status: NOT ACCEPTED (Codex 2026-09-28): the outer positive unloading branches cross zero force at 45-66 mm (branches above)

load_at_zero_displacement_kN.basis: the reloading branches at mu >= 4 cross delta = 0 at about +-25 to 30 kN on Fig. 16(a)
load_at_zero_displacement_kN.status: NOT ACCEPTED: no per-cycle identity; replaced by the signed bundles in independent_crossings

superseded_v1_targets.qualitative: pinching not significant (PEER Table 5.1); the paper: strength, stiffness and energy dissipation maintained well

run_label_audit.run_25: the second cycle at +105 mm reverses visibly lower than run 23 (pixel tips above); retained as printed, not removed
run_label_audit.cycle_pairs: where cycles_separable is false the two cycles at that amplitude and direction share one tip interval at the scan's resolution
run_label_audit.printed_numbers: run numbers 1-26 as printed on the figure; identity of each numbered reversal taken from its printed position

strength_retention.final_cycle_over_theoretical: about 100 % (PEER Table 5.1); the paper: strength degradation of Unit 1 at the end of testing was small

damage_observations.joint_hoop_strain: did not exceed about twice the yield strain (1.4e-3) (section 4.2, Fig. 17a)
damage_observations.beam_bar_strains: yielding penetrated into the joint core; bar stress below yield in the middle quarter of the joint; top bars yielded in tension only; bottom bars yielded in tension and compression in the beam but only in tension inside the joint (section 4.2 text, Fig. 20a)
damage_observations.failure_mode: beam plastic hinges at the column faces (negative moment) and near the gravity load point (positive moment); columns elastic; joint diagonal tension cracking well controlled

protocol.sequence: load-controlled cycle to +-0.75 V2, then displacement-controlled cycles, two at each of mu = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
protocol.yield_definition: Delta_y = (4/3) x 0.5 x (Delta_y1 + Delta_y2), the displacements at +-0.75 V2
